stories.title: CISA Adds One Known Exploited Vulnerability to Catalog
stories.summary: CISA has added one new vulnerability to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) Catalog , based on evidence of active exploitation.
stories.why_it_matters: Defenders should treat this as an immediate exposure-management priority, confirm whether affected systems are internet-facing, review available indicators, and apply verified vendor mitigations or updates.

stories.title: Attackers Target miniOrange SAML Flaws That Can Grant WordPress Admin Access
stories.summary: Bad actors are attempting to exploit two severe unauthenticated authentication bypasses in the Xecurify miniOrange SAML 2.0 Single Sign On plugin that make it possible for an attacker to sign in as any WordPress user, including administrators.
stories.why_it_matters: Organizations should inventory potentially affected products, review the original advisory, and monitor for credible exploitation evidence.
